# Synthetic test data

All names, identifiers, projects and commercial figures here are fictional.
These fixtures are not real agreements, user records or production seed data.
`v2_provider_output.json` is a synthetic fake-provider response for the website
project, with genuinely paraphrased descriptions. It is not live model output.
Milestones describe delivery only, not payments. No legal terms are supplied.

## V3 scope assessments

`v3/in_scope.json`, `v3/out_of_scope.json` and `v3/needs_clarification.json`
contain fictional client requests and optional untrusted context. Attach
`website_project.json` as `original_project` to obtain a complete V3 input.
`v3/provider_outputs.json` contains hand-authored fake-provider responses keyed
by case name; these are neither live AI outputs nor authoritative decisions.
Amounts/dates in source evidence are original facts or explicitly attributed
client proposals, never agreed modifications. All examples need human review.
